definitions.explanation: An automatic transmission, or a car equipped with one, which shifts gears by itself without a clutch pedal. A clipping of オートマチック (automatic); the opposite is マニュアル (manual).

examples.japanese: オートマの{方|ほう}が{運転|うんてん}が{楽|らく}だ。
examples.english: An automatic is easier to drive.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{免許|めんきょ}をオートマ{限定|げんてい}で{取|と}る{人|ひと}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Lately more people get an automatic-only driver's license.

notes:
Colloquial; also written AT. An "automatic-only" license is オートマ{限定|げんてい}{免許|めんきょ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- オートマ{車|しゃ}: automatic car
- オートマ{限定|げんてい}: automatic-only (license)
- オートマに{乗|の}る: to drive an automatic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- マニュアル: manual (transmission) — the driver changes gears with a clutch
- {半|はん}クラッチ: half-clutch — a manual-driving technique with no counterpart in an automatic
